region_annotation.limitations: Spatial overlap only: sv_type is retained for provenance but does not change this query. Nominal-interval and breakpoint-window results are reported separately; a parsed BND mate is also queried separately. A heuristic breakpoint window retrieves nearby features but is not a measured confidence interval. Results are capped per feature type; transcript, consequence, breakpoint, nearest-gene, and mappability annotation are not included. A null feature list means that feature query failed.

database_evidence.limitations: Similarity classes are deterministic screening labels, not proof of variant identity or biological effect. Heuristic windows are used only when VCF breakpoint confidence intervals are unavailable. BND records with a parsed mate are compared using both breakends and the chromosome pair, allowing reversed record order. Input orientation is retained but cannot be compared because it is absent from this gnomAD response. BND records without a mate retain first-breakend-only candidate matching. Adaptive retrieval padding, when nonzero, widens only the records retrieved from the API; it never widens the fixed matching windows. A gnomAD-SV absence does not establish novelty, pathogenicity, or technical validity.

vep_evidence.limitations: VEP consequences are predictions for the submitted interval and symbolic allele. They do not establish expression change, dosage pathogenicity, phenotype, penetrance, or the actual transcript expressed in a sample. Only a ranked compact subset of consequences is retained.

clingen_dosage_evidence.limitations: Dosage sensitivity is queried only for DEL, DUP, and CNV.

clinvar_evidence.limitations: ClinVar contains submitted aggregate interpretations with different review levels and possible conflicts. Exact displayed coordinates and compatible type do not establish the same biological event. Inner/outer bounds, condition, review status, and last evaluation must be considered; absence from this bounded search does not establish novelty or benignity.

verified_claims.notes: VEP-BL-001 confirms ENST00000308624 is the canonical transcript, the consequence is intron_variant (intron 1/16), and the impact is MODIFIER.

verified_claims.text: Ensembl VEP predicts intronic MODIFIER consequences for the insertion across multiple non-canonical SNTG2 transcripts, including some annotated with nonsense-mediated decay.
verified_claims.notes: VEP-BL-003 and VEP-BL-004 have nonsense_mediated_decay biotype and intronic MODIFIER consequences; others represent alternative transcripts with the same prediction.

verified_claims.text: The insertion breakpoint resides within a repeating genomic region annotated with tandem repeats of type 'trf'.
verified_claims.notes: Ensembl repeat records show tandem repeats of type 'trf' spanning both nominal and breakpoint coordinates.

verified_claims.text: Seven dbVar database entries (esv3656833, nsv3953858, nsv5618433, nsv5961524, nsv6053736, nsv6220675, nsv7862737) represent exact coordinate and type matches for an insertion variant at chromosome 2 coordinate 983,265.
verified_claims.notes: Matches verified. All seven records correspond exactly to an insertion at chromosome 2 coordinate 983265.

verified_claims.text: Three dbVar database entries (nsv2806727, nsv3366452, nsv3377346) represent nearby insertion variant matches situated 1 base pair away from the query coordinates.
verified_claims.notes: Verified. These database entries are marked as 'nearby' insertions at coordinate 983266, which is exactly 1 bp away.; Cited database records do not establish an exact or high-similarity match.

verified_claims.text: The matching and nearby dbVar records do not supply clinical significance findings for this insertion variant.
verified_claims.notes: Verified. The clinical_significance arrays for all ten dbVar records are empty.

verified_claims.text: Quality control evaluations indicate a repeat region is present at the breakpoints (6 start and 6 end repeat counts), which can make structural variant breakpoint placement less reliable.
verified_claims.notes: QC-BL-003 confirms repeat_region presence at breakpoints with 6 start/end counts and notes the risk to placement reliability.

verified_claims.text: A published literature title reports that Neuroligins 3 and 4X interact with syntrophin-gamma2 (SNTG2) and that these interactions are altered by autism-related mutations.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the publication title of PMID-17292328.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A published literature title describes monozygotic twins discordant for submicroscopic chromosomal anomalies in the 2p25.3 region.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-23061379.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A published study title reports on early-onset obesity associated with a paternal 2pter deletion encompassing ACP1, TMEM18, and MYT1L.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-24129437.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A study title describes genetic diagnosis and analysis of related genes in a pedigree presenting 2p25 and 12p13 cryptic rearrangements.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the translated title of PMID-25119907.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A published literature title links genomic structural variants to cases of intellectual disability.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-25626716.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A study title evaluates molecular karyotyping diagnostic efficacy and new variants in patients with isolated and complex autism spectrum disorder.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-29564645.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A published study title investigates mice deleted for Sox3 and uc482 to analyze their relevance to X-linked hypoparathyroidism.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-31961795.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A study title reports inherited L1 retrotransposon insertions associated with susceptibility to schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-34901866 ('Associated With Risk for Schizophrenia and Bipolar Disorder').; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A published study title indicates through gene-gene interaction network analysis that CNTN2 is a candidate gene for idiopathic generalized epilepsy.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-38460076.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A publication title describes genetic alterations observed in a large population of Italian patients affected by neurodevelopmental disorders.
verified_claims.notes: Matches the title of PMID-38674362.; Only PubMed citation metadata was retrieved; full-text support was not checked.

verified_claims.text: A causal connection cannot be established between this specific intronic insertion and SNTG2-associated neurodevelopmental, autism, or psychiatric phenotypes based solely on general gene-level literature and coordinate overlap.
verified_claims.notes: The inference is valid: the cited works establish only broad SNTG2 or regional associations, while the variant is predicted computationally to have a MODIFIER impact inside an intron.

investigation_log.stop_reason: All relevant evidence gaps have been addressed. SNTG2 is confirmed as the only gene near the insertion, and its intronic consequence is well-characterized by the VEP baseline results.
remaining_limitations: gnomAD-SV contains 26 type-incompatible records in the region which are excluded from the compatible count due to SV type differences (INS vs other types).
Breakpoint placement remains of medium risk due to multiple local tandem repeats (trf).
Ensembl VEP predictions are computational models of transcript-level consequences and do not represent validated functional splicing or expression outcomes in vivo.
NCBI dbVar records aggregate heterogeneous study submissions of varying technical platforms and do not guarantee validated coordinate precision or clinical associations.
The retrieved literature references only general gene associations or large regional rearrangements; none directly document or validate this specific 222 bp insertion.
The insertion is flanked by tandem repeat sequences which increases the likelihood of sequencing alignment errors and mapping ambiguity.
